limits_note: per-object-cap 50 GB; retention 7 days then automatic deletion. That 7-day window is the binding constraint, not the 50 GB.
reliability_note: Ukrainian file-exchange site, appears healthy. Useful as an egress-firehose (large objects, fast) rather than as a store.
